transcript.text: Back in 2025 I was commuting between cities a lot—one trip I remember was from Beijing to Shanghai, and it felt like half my week was spent on the move.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: And on that same stretch, I also remember people talking about what was playing in Beijing at the time—movies were basically the only downtime we had.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: My coworker Sun Lei had already gotten his ticket sorted for that run—train G3 on 2025-03-23, if I’m remembering the details right.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: He even joked he always picked Second Class anyway, since it was comfortable enough and didn’t feel like overpaying.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Later, my friend Xu Jing told me she’d already grabbed two seats for Article 20 at CGV Xidan—the 10:00 show—so we just showed up and watched it.
